# Random Generation

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Random based generation training

Fine-tune a molecular generator on a user-supplied SMILES library. The trained checkpoint becomes a private **Custom Generator** option in Random Generation — Inference. Training supports **VAE and CharRNN only**. TransVAE is inference-only in the current product and must never be sent to this training job.

Exact job name: `Random_based_generation_training`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataPath` | string | yes | file | Upload a molecule CSV for fine-tuning. The file must contain a non-empty `SMILES` column. |
| `num_epochs` | integer | yes | value | Fine-tuning epochs. Product guidance suggests 20–100 and starting near 40; use a small value only for an explicit smoke test. |
| `num_samples` | integer | yes | value | Molecules sampled per epoch. Product source maximum: 5000. The web UI currently sends 1000; the live API also accepted 100. |
| `model_name` | string | yes | value | Exact training choices are `vae` and `CharRNN`. |
| `model_filePath` | string | yes | value | Base checkpoint. Global defaults are `globalgenerators/vae_alldata.ckpt` for VAE and `globalgenerators/CharRNN_60Ldata.ckpt` for CharRNN. A prior compatible checkpoint may be used for further specialization. |
| `model_category` | string | yes | value | Use `"ML"`; the lower-level CSV calls this optional, but it was present in the verified submission. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected model objects with name, min_threshold and max_threshold; preserve user-supplied numeric bounds. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional custom property rewards: `{id, min_threshold, max_threshold}`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Random Generation — Inference

Generate chemically valid, diverse ligand-like molecules from either a global pretrained generator or a private fine-tuned generator. The product exposes three global models—**VAE, CharRNN, and TransVAE**—but TransVAE uses a different job and payload. Route by model before submitting.

Exact job name: `Random_based_generation_nontrans`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `num_samples` | integer | yes | value | Positive number of molecules requested. Sampling is nondeterministic. |
| `model_name` | string | yes | value | Exact inference choices are `vae` and `CharRNN`. |
| `prop_model_category` | string | yes | value | Use `"ML"`. |
| `global_models` | array | yes | value | Selected model objects with name, min_threshold and max_threshold; preserve user-supplied numeric bounds. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value |  |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Random Generation — Inference

Generate chemically valid, diverse ligand-like molecules from either a global pretrained generator or a private fine-tuned generator. The product exposes three global models—**VAE, CharRNN, and TransVAE**—but TransVAE uses a different job and payload. Route by model before submitting.

Exact job name: `Random_based_generation_Inference_transvaegen`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `num_epochs` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Send `0`; TransVAE is inference-only here. |
| `num_samples` | integer | yes | value | Number of accepted molecules requested. |
| `model_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Send `"transvae"`. |
| `dataPath` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Current frontend sends `""`; no input dataset is required. |
| `model_category` | string | yes | value | GraphDTA conditioning is not available in the clarification choices for this mode. |
| `mode` | integer | yes | value | `0` for regression. Product source also mentions classification modes 7, 8, or 9. |
| `global_models` | array | yes | value | Selected model objects with name, min_threshold and max_threshold; preserve user-supplied numeric bounds. |
| `prop_model_category` | string | no / mode-dependent | value |  |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value |  |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.
